title: CVE-2026-42897: crafted email triggering OWA XSS on on-prem Exchange

source.telemetry: Exchange Server IIS/OWA request log correlated with Defender for Endpoint browser telemetry
source.detection: OWA request containing script payload in a rendered message context
source.provenance_note: Reconstructed from the public CVE description and vendor advisory. No exploit code was obtained or run; the request shape below is illustrative of the described attack path, not a captured exploitation attempt.

intel.status: Actively exploited; added to CISA KEV 2026-05-15
intel.summary: A cross-site scripting flaw in Outlook Web Access. An attacker sends a crafted email; when the recipient opens it in OWA and certain interaction conditions are met, attacker-supplied JavaScript executes in the browser context of the authenticated mail session.
intel.why_this_matters: Execution happens inside an authenticated OWA session, so the script inherits the victim's mail context. Natural follow-on is silent inbox-rule creation or token theft -- which is why this pairs directly with the two BEC scenarios in this library.
observed_kill_chain: Crafted email delivered to on-prem Exchange mailbox
Victim opens the message in Outlook Web Access
Attacker JavaScript executes in the authenticated session context
Follow-on: mail exfiltration, inbox rule creation, or session token theft

alert.description: Possible CVE-2026-42897 exploitation: script payload in OWA message render request

fields.Product: Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 CU14 (unpatched -- below the 2026-06-09 security update)
fields.MessageSubject: RE: Outstanding invoice 8841 -- payment confirmation required

analyst_note: Check the Exchange build number first. If the server is past the 2026-06-09 update this is a failed attempt worth logging, not an incident. SPF fail plus DKIM none plus a financial subject line is the BEC pretext wrapper this CVE is being delivered inside.
